mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS players ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS games ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, started_at TEXT, finished_at TEXT, winner TEXT, winner_player_id INTEGER, rounds INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (winner_player_id) REFERENCES players(id) )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rounds ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, game_id INTEGER NOT NULL, round_number INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (game_id) REFERENCES games(id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scores ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, game_id INTEGER NOT NULL, player_id INTEGER, player_name TEXT, score INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (game_id) REFERENCES games(id), FOREIGN KEY (player_id) REFERENCES players(id) )
ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN winner_player_id INTEGER
ALTER TABLE scores ADD COLUMN player_id INTEGER
mapper.insert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO players (name) VALUES (#{name})

INSERT INTO games (started_at, finished_at, winner, winner_player_id, rounds)
VALUES (#{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{winner}, #{winnerPlayerId}, #{rounds})
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, p.name AS winner, COUNT(r.id) AS rounds, g.finished_at FROM games g LEFT JOIN players p ON p.id = g.winner_player_id LEFT JOIN rounds r ON r.game_id = g.id GROUP BY g.id, p.name, g.finished_at ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM games g JOIN players p ON p.id = g.winner_player_id WHERE p.name = #{player}
SELECT p.name AS player_name, s.score FROM scores s JOIN players p ON p.id = s.player_id ORDER BY s.score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
